periods.time: Night after the US fleet retreats from Tokyo

name.zh: 破军庆功夜与小一辉澡堂事故
name.en: Hagun Victory Night and Mini-Ikki's Bath Misadventure

periods.location: Tokyo celebration streets, public bath, and Hagun dormitory
periods.summary: Tokyo celebrates survival while Kagami multiplies herself to interview soldiers and civilians. Stella, Shizuku and Alice reunite with friends, but child-sized Ikki gets lost in the crowd. Ayase mistakes the blood-covered miniature Ikki for an injured boy and takes him to a public bath; because the men's side is overcrowded, he is dragged into the women's side. Toka recognizes him by bioelectric current and helps him keep his eyes closed, but Stella and Shizuku see him exit and the secret collapses. Stella takes him back to Hagun and scolds him, then demands they bathe together as compensation.
periods.cause: Ikki's temporary child body makes him unrecognizable, and his bloodstained clothes worry Ayase during the victory crowds.
periods.process: Kagami and Alice report and walk through the celebration. Stella asks after Ikki, but he has drifted away. Ayase finds him, disbelieves his identity and brings him to a bath. Toka notices his familiar bioelectric pattern and quietly covers for him. After Stella catches him exiting the women's bath, she interprets the situation as an unforgivable accident, then reveals her jealousy is partly that other women got to bathe with child Ikki first.
periods.outcome: The comedic misunderstanding resolves with Stella and Ikki bathing together at the dormitory, leading into their private conversation about their future.
periods.significance: Provides postwar decompression, reunites the Hagun cast, clarifies Ikki's child-body condition to friends, and transitions into the romantic promise scene before the abduction.
